data.name: Iqraasam
data.gender_notes: Iqraasam is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Iqraasam is derived from the Arabic verb 'iqr', which means 'to read' or 'to recite'. In the context of Islamic history, Iqraasam refers to the Angel Jibreel (Gabriel) who recites the Quran to Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). This name symbolizes the importance of knowledge and the act of reading or reciting the holy text. The name Iqraasam carries the meaning “To read, to recite” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Iqraasam usually hope their child will grow to embody to read, to recite and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies knowledge and the pursuit of truth.
data.etymology: Iqraasam belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “To read, to recite.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Iqraasam total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: إقراصم
in_arabic.meaning: واحد من الأسماء التي تدل على التذكير بالقرآن
